about_the_game:
Order Up! is a fast-paced and deeply immersive restaurant simulation game where you take full control of a rising burger joint in a bustling city.
From slicing vegetables in the kitchen to managing deliveries, upgrading your layout, handling difficult customers, or even surviving random power outages—everything is in your hands.

Whether you're flipping patties on the grill, fulfilling rush-hour orders, or expanding your tiny diner into a full-blown franchise, Order Up! combines chaos with creativity in the most addictive way possible.

💡 Core Features
• Fully manual burger assembly with physical ingredients
• Diverse customer personalities, from slow diners to impatient office workers
• Stock up your kitchen via wholesale deliveries and manage your storage
• Power outages, food spoilage, reputation systems, and more immersive events
• Highly interactive gameplay with hands-on controls and realistic challenges
• Stylized low-poly visuals and atmospheric day-night cycle

Are you ready to build the most iconic burger place in town—or will your reputation go up in smoke?
